recommendation: Keep this source fix. No broader Immunization.reaction or AdverseEvent workflow guidance change is needed for FHIR-14238 because the conformance targets are already present and later workflow questions were resolved separately.
issue_request: FHIR-14238 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested that AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance support Immunization; the final resolution expanded the target set to Reference(Immunization|Procedure|Substance|Medication|MedicationAdministration|MedicationStatement|Device).
initial_application: Commit b88fc91916dd76f6587b8f326b9ea447d69381cd applied GF#14238 to the legacy AdverseEvent spreadsheet by adding Immunization and Procedure to the suspectEntity.instance Reference target list. Later StructureDefinition source rework preserved those targetProfiles, but the old definition sentence still named only substance, medication, medication administration, medication statement, or device.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists AdverseEvent as an active resource, so source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml is current build input. FHIR-15124 and the 2018 Zulip discussion restored or retained Immunization.reaction for documenting the reaction itself and rejected Immunization guidance preferring AdverseEvent, but they did not reverse the approved AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance target support.
reconciliation: Changed only the AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance definition to remove the stale non-exhaustive example sentence while leaving the current targetProfile list unchanged.
source_changes: source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml: simplified AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance definition from a stale narrow example list to a generic definition aligned with the full targetProfile list.

related_jiras.note: Resolved No Change Immunization reaction-detail request that referenced the contemporaneous request to enhance AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance with Immunization.
Later Resolved No Change issue rejected adding guidance that preferred AdverseEvent for immunization reactions, without removing Immunization from AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance.
Later Published AdverseEvent cleanup changed nearby supporting information and causality elements, confirming later AdverseEvent refactoring did not supersede FHIR-14238 target support.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance to support Immunization and Procedure in addition to the existing medication, substance, and device targets.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the approved conformance target expansion that current AdverseEvent source must preserve.

evidence_items.summary: source/fhir.ini lists AdverseEvent as an active resource and maps adverseevent to AdverseEvent.
evidence_items.learned: The AdverseEvent StructureDefinition source is in current FHIR build scope.

evidence_items.summary: AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance includes targetProfiles for Immunization, Procedure, Substance, SubstanceDefinition, Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationStatement, Device, BiologicallyDerivedProduct, and ResearchStudy; this reconciliation simplified the definition to avoid stale narrower examples.
evidence_items.learned: The conformance list already supports the requested references, and removing the outdated example sentence prevents implementers from reading a narrower prose rule.

evidence_items.summary: The GF#14238 application commit changed the legacy AdverseEvent spreadsheet target type to include Immunization and Procedure.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was applied historically, but the old prose examples survived later source transformations.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive issue concluding that Immunization.reaction should document the reaction itself and that proposed AdverseEvent preference guidance should not be added.
evidence_items.learned: This later decision affects workflow guidance but does not supersede the approved AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.instance targetProfile support for Immunization.

evidence_items.learned: The community history supports treating Immunization.reaction workflow guidance as separate from the conformance allowance corrected here.
